{\newcommand{\offset}{2}
\begin{theorem}\label{a}For every $x\in\mathbb{Z}$,
\[(x+\offset)^2=x^2+2*\offset*x+\offset^2.\]\end{theorem}}
{\begin{theorem}\label{b}For every $x\in\mathbb{Z}$,
\[(x+3)^2=x^2+6x+9.\]\end{theorem}}
